description: This PHP class defines a 'HolidayModel' for the OrangeHRM HRM system, representing holiday entities with serialization capabilities. It implements the 'Normalizable' interface, uses traits for serialization, and maps entity attributes for API responses.

classes.name: HolidayModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing 'Holiday' entity data for API responses within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayModel with a Holiday entity and sets up attribute filters and names for serialization.
